caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wall clock with a wide, reddish-brown wooden frame. The clock is vertically oriented and divided into two main sections. The upper section contains a circular white clock face with black Roman numerals and black minute and hour hands, as well as a visible circular mechanism area at the center. The lower section beneath the clock face features a painted scene showing a multi-story white building with columns and smaller surrounding structures, set in a green landscape with trees and hills in the background. In the foreground of the scene, there is a red object and what appears to be a decorative horizontal band with the text "VIEW NEAR UTICA" printed in capital letters. Below this painted scene is a stylized, ornate green border with scroll patterns and a small rectangular opening. The entire clock is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Pendulum Clock
